journal: Journal of Human-Centred Education, Learning and Assessment
principle: Design to international scholarly-publishing requirements; current hosting is a transitional constraint only.

platformStrategy.application: Native OJS modular monolith with supported plugins/interfaces

plannedUpgrade.whenAvailable: Check actual disk quota, inode count, DB limit, PHP extensions, TLS, backup and privacy; never infer launch readiness from disk.

logicalZones.technologies: TLS, WAF, rate limits, CDN for anonymous immutable assets only
never: cache private sessions or review files

logicalZones.technologies: Version-pinned supported OJS, PHP-FPM, shared code on release, strong sessions, RBAC
Dedicated transactional relational database, point-in-time recovery when available
never: share credentials or tables with website commerce

logicalZones.technologies: OJS-compatible POSIX file service/volume outside every web root, restrictive permissions, tested migration
never: assume native OJS 3.5 supports direct S3 files_dir
public CDN delivery of private files

logicalZones.technologies: Scheduled jobs via OS scheduler and controlled OJS queue/job runner, consented transactional SMTP
never: duplicate publishing/invoicing jobs on multiple nodes
send confidential submission content to analytics

logicalZones.technologies: Native OJS galleys, accessibility, ISBN/ISSN as verified, Crossref when authorised, public preservation
never: release material prior to editorial acceptance

logicalZones.technologies: Future invoicing, waivers, reconciliation, refunds through legal payment service and minimal accepted-article interface
never: collect card data in the journal database

logicalZones.technologies: Redacted append-only operations/security event log, privacy-preserving aggregates, per-role viewing
never: log manuscript bodies, upload payloads or blind identities
treat absent integrations as zero activity

logicalZones.technologies: Encryption, distinct account/provider/location when possible, 3-2-1 practice, immutable backups and tested restore
never: store the only backup on same hosting filesystem

scaleStages.target: Existing hosting + planned 5 GB temporary increase
scaleStages.description: Do not bend editorial requirements to the present host. Only prepare data/brand/contracts; run OJS there only after all native technical, privacy and TLS gates pass.
scaleStages.gate: Server security and full staging manuscript workflow audited

scaleStages.target: Dedicated or managed VPS with separate private database and encrypted off-host backups
scaleStages.description: OJS application on supported PHP runtime; dedicated managed DB, private mounted file storage outside public files, TLS/WAF, external mail, log/audit and reserve capacity.
scaleStages.gate: Observed reliability, backup restore, load/error measurements

scaleStages.target: High availability OJS with compatible shared state
scaleStages.description: Multiple PHP application instances only if OJS sessions, plugins, shared POSIX file store and job ownership have passed concurrency/failover testing. Dedicated DB failover; caches and analytics isolated.
scaleStages.gate: Demonstrated multi-node correctness with same-document editing, job idempotency, restored backup and failover drills

scaleStages.target: Multi-journal publisher, not a compulsory microservice rewrite
scaleStages.description: Multiple native OJS journals or verified publisher tenant configuration, separately governed journals, shared institutional services for public metadata only; distinct financial/legal policies; independent board authority.
scaleStages.gate: Actual governance, staff, funding and audit capacity with no tenant data leakage

objectStorageCompatibility.nativeManuscripts: OJS-compatible private POSIX filesystem until a vendor-supported adapter is proven with failover and recovery
objectStorageCompatibility.s3AllowedNow: encrypted backups, public archive copies/derivatives only when authorised and independent of OJS files_dir

integrationBoundary.design: Versioned adapters, immutable event IDs and signed server-to-server authentication
integrationBoundary.apiSource: Verified and supported OJS 3.5 API/hook/plugin surface, not assumed arbitrary endpoints
integrationBoundary.direction: Read-only projection of authorised aggregate statuses to existing master site, with isolated finance/audit access

capacityPlanning.basis: Real observed throughput, file volume, seasonal submissions, retention and backup sizes

afterVerifiedLaunch.applicationUptimeTarget: 99.9% monthly aspiration, verify monitoring and support capacity
afterVerifiedLaunch.recoveryTimeObjective: <=24h initial target; <=4h after tested failover and documented operations

migrationGates: Inventory real OJS version/plugins, DB, upload files, roles and current public URL mappings
Prove destination PHP/MySQL compatibility, TLS, private files, SMTP and backup restore
Dry-run migration using sanitised/staging copies; negative-authorization and full review tests
Set safe cutover window and independent data freeze; snapshot consistent DB and private files
Restore destination and reconcile counts, file hashes, permissions and blinded reports
Verify canonical host, one-hop redirects only after true destination is functioning, canonical/hreflang, cache isolation
Permit writes on one origin only and monitor actual errors with rollback checkpoint
Record owner approval, rollback decision criteria and no split-brain reactivation
